verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents H100 machines, which require approval to use, alongside A100s with up to 8 GPUs, and a user reports running a Quadro P6000. That shows a mix of current and previous-generation GPU choices. However, H200 and B200 options are not evidenced, and H100 access is gated. Missing for 10: H200/B200-class availability, a documented full GPU catalog with pricing tiers for previous-gen options, independent corroboration of H100 availability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.
